class: Running only the tests of the files a change touched, per batch, misses the repo-wide gates (structure scans, import rules, the generated API description): they fail late and all at once.
mechanism: Each batch ran its own files' tests; the gates that read the whole tree ran only at the end.

first_seen.where: GC-ICFIX final gate run, 15 Nov 2026, head f8bd1957 and earlier
first_seen.evidence: Three gate failures found about 28 commits after their cause: a domain test that imports the app (test_no_app_imports, 1 failed 1468 passed in gate-repo_scan_tests.log), a test fake without the limit property, and a stale docs/api/openapi.json. Repaired in ce584493, f8bd1957, 874aacd5; then ci_local 16 passed and repo_scan 1469 passed.

fix: Run the repo-wide gates (ci_local first gate, repo_scan, interface check) after every merge batch, not at the end.

detection.note: Process finding: only a habit and the earlier lesson (run its first gate after every merge batch). No mechanism enforces it.
